title: ZAP relies on default locale when it shouldn't
body:
Throughout the codebase ZAP is relying on default locale when it shouldn't, which might lead to issues. For example, in Turkish the letter `I` is converted to `ı` not `i`, thus it would fail to match the expected string:
```
478506 [ZAP-ProxyThread-25] ERROR org.zaproxy.zap.ZAP$UncaughtExceptionLogger  - Exception in thread "ZAP-ProxyThread-25"
java.util.MissingResourceException: Can't find resource for bundle java.util.PropertyResourceBundle, key api.error.does_not_exıst
	at java.base/java.util.ResourceBundle.getObject(ResourceBundle.java:544)
	at java.base/java.util.ResourceBundle.getObject(ResourceBundle.java:538)
	at java.base/java.util.ResourceBundle.getString(ResourceBundle.java:501)
	at org.zaproxy.zap.utils.I18N.getString(I18N.java:81)
	at org.zaproxy.zap.extension.api.ApiException.toJSON(ApiException.java:184)
	at org.zaproxy.zap.extension.api.ApiException.toString(ApiException.java:173)
	at org.zaproxy.zap.extension.api.API.handleException(API.java:885)
	at org.zaproxy.zap.extension.api.API.handleApiRequest(API.java:549)
	at org.parosproxy.paros.core.proxy.ProxyThread.processHttp(ProxyThread.java:456)
	at org.parosproxy.paros.core.proxy.ProxyThread.run(ProxyThread.java:317)
	at java.base/java.lang.Thread.run(Thread.java:844)
```
or
```

java.util.MissingResourceException: Can't find resource for bundle java.util.PropertyResourceBundle, key ascan.policy.level.medıum
	at java.base/java.util.ResourceBundle.getObject(ResourceBundle.java:544)

	at java.base/java.util.ResourceBundle.getString(ResourceBundle.java:501)

	at org.zaproxy.zap.extension.ascan.PolicyAllCategoryPanel.getTableTest(PolicyAllCategoryPanel.java:421)
	at org.zaproxy.zap.extension.ascan.PolicyAllCategoryPanel.getJScrollPane(PolicyAllCategoryPanel.java:485)
	at org.zaproxy.zap.extension.ascan.PolicyAllCategoryPanel.initialize(PolicyAllCategoryPanel.java:191)
```

ZAP
Version 2.7.0 (and older).
